instruction: Walk into the living room and keep walking straight past the living room. Then walk into the entrance under the balcony. Wait in the entrance to the other room.

steps.thought: I'm in the living room with a balcony above and an arched entrance directly ahead. I'll walk straight toward that arch.
The arched entrance under the balcony is directly ahead, slightly right of center. I'll advance toward it and then stop in the entrance.
The arched entrance under the balcony is directly ahead and roughly aligned. I'll advance toward it a few steps, then re-observe before entering.
I'm in the living room facing the arched entrance under the balcony. I need to walk through it and stop in the entrance to the next room.
I have walked through the living room and reached the arched entrance under the balcony, which leads to the other room. This is the spot described, so I will stop here.
